summary: Persist the fresh P2 Context-Fidelity preflight against main@63883532af7834b5e46a84cef665ef4cfaa25a98, disposition the 2026-09-18/19 audit deltas, integrate the independent NEEDS CORRECTION review by making positive bounded selection and selection provenance falsifiable, and expose only a blocked Human implementation-admission decision without authorizing P2 implementation.

This remains a bounded proposal, not accepted architecture or implementation authority; a new persistent fidelity/state layer and hidden deterministic relevance classifier are rejected.

No executable P2 implementation action becomes ready: implementation admission remains blocked and implementation_allowed remains false.

active_work.rationale: No P2 implementation is active. Within this open PR, the remaining promotion gate is qualitative re-review of the corrected preflight; the separate implementation-admission proposal remains blocked and absence of admission is preserved as non-generative state.
